note: Reference points used to calibrate the cost of living index. Values are cost-of-living indexes with the US at 100, read from published C2ER-derived sources on 2026-08-22, plus the two Forbes figures already recorded in README-coli.md. Stored so the fit can be re-checked and re-run rather than re-derived from memory.

sources.c2er_derived: RentCafe cost of living calculator, which publishes C2ER Cost of Living Index values. Data last published March 2026.
sources.forbes: The two Forbes figures recorded in README-coli.md: Los Angeles and Portland to Myrtle Beach on $70,000.

caveats: RentCafe values are for the named CITY. Our data is METRO level. Myrtle Beach city and the Myrtle Beach metro are not the same place.
Published sources disagree about Myrtle Beach by 14 points: RentCafe 92, Redfin 93, HomeSnacks 106, Salary.com about 106.
Seven reference points is a small fit. Treat the constant as a correction, not a measurement.
